title: Cancel Your Hidden Amazon Prime Video Add-Ons
hook_text: YOUR PRIME ACCOUNT HIDES SECRET MONTHLY FEES

beats.say: Your Amazon account has a quiet leak draining your checking account every single month.
beats.visual: A dark wooden desk with a single steaming mug, cinematic moody lighting, top-down shot.

beats.say: Most people forget they signed up for premium channels and video add-ons through Prime.
beats.visual: A pair of hands resting on a clean desk, no screens visible, warm lamplight.

beats.say: That forgotten $15 monthly subscription quietly adds up to $1,800 over 10 years.
beats.visual: A close-up of a silver key resting on a dark marble surface, soft focus.

beats.say: Let's hunt them down right now in under two minutes. Step one.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a wooden chair back from a minimalist desk, side profile shadow.

beats.say: Open your web browser and log into your primary Amazon account settings.
beats.visual: A close-up of a hand turning a brass door knob in a dim hallway, cinematic shadows.

beats.say: Step two. Navigate to your memberships and subscriptions tab under your account menu.
beats.visual: Fingers flipping through the pages of a closed leather-bound notebook, overhead view.

beats.say: Step three. Click on Prime Video Channels and check every single active subscription listed there.
beats.visual: A hand placing a ceramic coffee cup down on a dark slate coaster.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions. Amazon buries these menus deep inside settings.
beats.visual: A dark room illuminated by a single warm desk lamp, moody shadows on the wall.

beats.say: Cancel every channel you haven't watched in the last thirty days without hesitation.
beats.visual: A hand closing a dark journal completely, sharp focus, minimalist aesthetic.

beats.say: Redirect that recovered cash toward an index fund compounding at 8% a year.
beats.visual: A brass desk lamp casting a warm glow on an empty wooden table.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person walking away down a dimly lit corridor, cinematic grade.

caption: Stop letting Amazon quietly bleed your bank account dry every month. Hunt down those forgotten video add-ons and redirect your cash toward your future. #money #personalfinance #budgeting #finances #savingmoney
description: Learn how to find and cancel hidden Amazon Prime video add-on subscriptions that drain your checking account every month. A quick 3-step audit you can do today.
first_comment: How many hidden subscriptions did you find in your account?
